name: Asset Management
description: Funds and mandates: AUM, flows, fees, and investment performance versus benchmark.

dimensions.name: vehicle
dimensions.description: Mutual fund, ETF, separate account, private fund

metrics.name: aum
metrics.description: Assets under management at a point in time

metrics.name: net_flows
metrics.description: Subscriptions minus redemptions in the period

metrics.name: management_fee_rate
metrics.description: Annualized management fees divided by average AUM

metrics.name: excess_return
metrics.description: Portfolio return minus benchmark return over the period

metrics.name: tracking_error
metrics.description: Annualized standard deviation of excess returns

metrics.name: information_ratio
metrics.description: Annualized excess return divided by tracking error

conventions.rule: State gross or net of fees, the currency, and time-weighted or money-weighted returns.
Multi-period returns compound geometrically; never add period returns.
Excess return is always against the mandate's stated benchmark for the same period.

insight_rules.reason: Use a performance attribution (allocation, selection) instead of additive contribution of returns.

caveats.text: Closed or merged funds drop out of databases; averages across funds can be survivorship-biased.
Risk-adjusted ratios over short windows are statistically weak; state the window length.

chart_conventions.rule: Show cumulative performance as growth of 1 (or 100) against the benchmark on the same axis.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
